Priya —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A couple of procurement/legal items we need to confirm before I can push the PO to finance: 

1) COI endorsement: our standard requirement is Redwood Inference, Inc. listed as "Certificate Holder" and an Additional Insured endorsement on the general liability policy, plus waiver of subrogation. The COI you sent shows an addendum but the endorsement language appears to be insurer-specific and not the standard form. Can you get your broker to issue an endorsement with Redwood Inference, Inc. (100 Redwood Ave, San Francisco, CA 94107) as additional insured and waiver of subrogation?

2) Limits: general liability at $1M per occurrence, $2M aggregate is required. Your COI currently lists $1M/$1M — will you be able to arrange the $2M aggregate? If not, procurement needs escalation/approval.

3) Cyber insurance: we require at least $1M cyber liability for vendors who process customer data. If your cyber limit is lower, provide the policy name and we will route to security for review.

4) W‑9: Thanks — finance will need a scanned copy with the signatory name visible (the PDF you provided appears to be a redacted image).

5) Bank verification: for payment setup we require a secure bank verification exercise. Please complete the Vendor_Bank_Info_Form and follow the DocuSign link below for bank account verification so finance can schedule the first payment.

DocuSign link: https://docusign.com/secure/ABC123-escale-bank-verif
Procurement ticket: JIRA-PROC-8172

I copied Monica (procurement ops) and Lauren (legal ops) — Monica will coordinate PO creation once endorsements and W‑9 are clarified.

Thanks,
Sergio Alvarez

Priya —

Legal reviewed the COI and subcontractor list. A couple of requests:

- Subcontractor disclosure: the spreadsheet lists subcontractors by name but not by scope. Please add a short column describing the type of work (e.g., data processing, install services, subcontractor support). This helps us assess third‑party risk mapping.

- Endorsement language: we can accept ISO CG 20 10 or an insurer-specific equivalent that grants additional insured status for ongoing operations and waives subrogation. If the insurer insists on a different form, please have them include language that references Redwood Inference, Inc. by name and the PO number once issued.

- If Escale cannot increase aggregate limits to $2M immediately, provide a statement of intent and estimated timeline — we may still be able to proceed with a conditional PO for up to 30 days while the endorsement is obtained, but Finance will withhold onboarding the first invoice until confirmed.

Copying Markus from Security for cyber coverage intake.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
